{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales_df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the 'channel' and 'customer_segment' columns for unique values
channels = sales_df['channel'].unique()
segments = sales_df['customer_segment'].unique()

# Check for any unexpected values or inconsistencies
print("Channels:", channels)
print("Customer Segments:", segments)

# Also check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()
print("Missing values:", missing_values)"}
